sources.name: Montana Secretary of State, FEDERAL GENERAL 2026 Candidate List (November 3, 2026). Party Preference codes are printed as DEM, REP, LIB, IND, and NON; the page legend reads DEM = Democratic, REP = Republican, LIB = Libertarian, IND = Independent, MP = Minor Party, NON = Non Partisan. A leading asterisk is the page’s incumbent marker and is not part of the name. Jami Dee Woodman’s Email/Web field reads WRITE-IN; Party Preference remains NON.
